The nbfx Output API is the contract of the output consoles: the OutputConsole service, the ConsolePanel handles it gives out and the ConsoleRun of an activity writing to one.
Build, run and test activities write into named consoles obtained from the OutputConsole service. The contract has no toolkit type: a console takes text from any thread, and an activity tells its console how to run it again and, from its start to its end, how to stop it. The platform's Output window (platform.output, an implementation module that publishes nothing) provides the service and shows the consoles. Writers, colours, hyperlinks and folds are not part of the contract yet.
Build and Run commands stream the tool output into a console and show it.
A build tells its console how to run it again and how to stop it.
The contract is exercised by the tests of its implementation and of the build runner. The API is under development.
A JDK is required only to compile.
Only org.netbeans.api.nbfx.output is public.
Clients find OutputConsole in the global Lookup.
